items.question: How many days did the UAE's Suqia water campaign take to collect over AED180 million?
items.fact: Suqia campaign collected over AED180 million in 18 days.

items.question: How many people was the UAE's Suqia water campaign launched to provide access to fresh drinking water for?
items.fact: Suqia campaign aimed to provide fresh drinking water to 5 million people.
